command: Drosophila melanogaster Mst27D localizes to the microtubule plus end, binds microtubule plus ends, and regulates microtubule polymerization or depolymerization. Evaluate each actual GO claim independently from primary experiments. Distinguish preferential plus-end tracking from any plus-end binding or localization capacity, full-length from truncated constructs, and endogenous postmeiotic expression from ectopic assays.
